Summarise Individual Patient Data from DES Results

summarise_ipd.Rd

Extracts total costs and QALYs from raw WARDEN DES simulation output, organises them into a [samples x treatments x patients] array, and returns the mean across patients for each sample and treatment arm.

Usage

summarise_ipd(res_list, n_samples, n_patients)

Arguments

res_list

List of length n_samples. Each element is a WARDEN simulation result containing a merged_df data frame with columns evtname, arm, pat_id, total_costs, and total_qalys.

n_samples

Integer. Number of PSA samples (outer loop iterations).

n_patients

Integer. Number of simulated patients per sample.

Value

A named list with two elements:

costs

Numeric matrix [n_samples x n_treatments] of mean total discounted costs per patient, averaged across n_patients.

qalys

Numeric matrix [n_samples x n_treatments] of mean total discounted QALYs per patient, averaged across n_patients.

Details

Only rows where evtname == "death" are used, as these carry each patient's cumulative costs and QALYs at the end of their simulated lifetime. The function relies on two objects from the global environment set by msdes::rrmsdessetup():

  • v_treatment_names — character vector of treatment arm names, used to name array dimensions and build the treatment index.

  • n_treatments — integer count of treatment arms, used to size the array.

See also

rrmsdessetup, rrmsdesmodel

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rrmsdessetup(drc = 0.035, drq = 0.035, time_horizon = 70,
                    p_eid = 0, jcvtest_cost = 0)
rrmsdesmodel(n_patients = 10, n_samples = 10)

ipdcesummary <- summarise_ipd(
  res_list   = results[[1]],
  n_samples  = 10,
  n_patients = 10
)

} # }
